name: Aftermath
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Sui’s official X account issued a reminder stating that the X account of Aftermath, a liquid staking protocol in the Sui ecosystem, has been compromised. Users are advised not to interact with the account until the team regains control.
